title: Cosmic Third Eye Awakening
description: A surreal painted portrait of a woman's face with closed eyes and cracked texture on the left side, surrounded by glowing mandalas, floating runes, and cosmic orbs. Radiating beams of rainbow light emanate from her head against a vibrant cosmic background filled with stars and nebulae.
